description: This file defines the UserRoleManagerService class, responsible for managing user role managers within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for retrieving the class name of the user role manager, instantiating it, and associating it with the current logged-in user. It also relies on various traits and interacts with configuration, logging, user services, and authorization management.

classes.name: UserRoleManagerService
classes.description: Service class that handles retrieval and instantiation of user role management objects based on configuration, and associates them with the current user.

methods.name: getUserRoleManagerClassName
methods.description: Retrieves the class name of the user role manager from configuration settings.

methods.name: getUserRoleManager
methods.description: Instantiates and returns the user role manager object if the class exists and is valid, and sets the current user context.
